notes.title: Update v1.2
notes.content:
I'm pleased to share with you the details of this new update v1.2, where new and improved sound effects were added to create a more terrifying atmosphere. The HUD system was also enhanced, and the errors that occasionally appeared in the objective system were corrected. Finally, the achievement system compatible with Steam was implemented, allowing players to experience a real sense of progress.

I'll keep an eye on the community feedback for upcoming updates.



Thank you all for making this possible [b]<3[/b]
[i]~ Kros[/i]

notes.title: Errors and added new features.
notes.content:
[b] We have fixed errors and added new features. [/b]

Mistakes:

- Error in the curtains.

- Translation error in warning message.

[b]------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/b]

New features:

- User settings can now be saved.

- You can end the presentation call.

- We have improved the sound of the steps.

------------------

Thanks to the whole community.

- KalaOh games

notes.title: Patch v0.10
notes.content:
[b]We have fixed some errors that the community has reported to us on our Discord server[/b]
( https://discord.gg/RsX4eGw )

- We have moved the basement closet.

- We have fixed that the character walks trembling.

- We have fixed that HUDs do not collapse.

- And finally, that the doll kills you inside the closet, we have also fixed it.

Thank you to the community for your support.

- KalaOh Games
